settings.title: Formulated to a stated dose
settings.body: Most wellness brands tell you a formula is “enriched with” something. That is a description, not a dose. We print the quantity of every active exactly as it appears on the pack — 500 mg Ashwagandha root, 10% Niacinamide, 400 mg Berberine — and where a pack does not declare one, we say so instead of filling the gap with language.

settings.title: Made where we say it is made
settings.body: Manufactured at a GMP-certified facility — Kenko Healthcare, Panchkula — and marketed by Helbrede Healthcare Ltd. Both names are printed on every pack, which is not universal in this category. FSSAI registered, AYUSH compliant, ISO certified and lab tested.
settings.proof: FSSAI · AYUSH · ISO · GMP · Lab tested

settings.title: Both halves of the routine
settings.body: We make the tablet you take and the serum you apply. So a hair plan can be Biotin, Zinc and Selenium in the morning and a scalp serum at night — a full day, not a single bottle. Most brands can only sell you one half of that, because they only make one half.

settings.title: A person on the phone
settings.body: Ayurveda is not one-size-fits-all and a product page can only take you so far. Our consultants will talk it through at no charge, and they are allowed to tell you that you do not need a supplement at all.
